intendedAnchor.name: ground-wash-origin
intendedAnchor.basis: Intended unseen ground contact in the full canvas; low horizontal flow spreads away from the centre. Visual calibration pending engine integration.

prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept, one production 2D cinematic material VFX sprite for Yautja The Long Hunt.
Asset ID: arrival-ship-ground-wash-jungle. Biome: jungle.
Use the first supplied sprite ONLY for realistic painted 2.5D material detail and soft alpha edges; use the second screenshot ONLY for near-ground camera and restrained painted game look. Do NOT reproduce its capsule, ship, characters, background, ground plane, interface or text. Do NOT copy the tall impact shape: this new effect is MUCH LOWER AND GENTLER.
Create ONE isolated soft ground wash: a low, wide, asymmetrical horizontal flow of displaced surface material, as an unseen landing craft gently pushes air sideways across the ground. The flow originates at full-canvas normalized (.5,.78) and spreads left and right, strongest low down, thin and transparent in the middle. This is sustained low-speed ground wash, NOT an explosion or capsule impact. Material description: Damp dark jungle topsoil fines, sparse tiny torn olive and umber leaf litter, wispy neutral grey-brown humid dust. A few irregular leaf edges drift sideways in the thin flow; no large leaf, branches or mound.
Composition: full landscape canvas 1536×1024, contact origin at pixel(768,799). The sparse effect lies entirely between x=15%..85% and y=54%..84%, with its most visible denser material in y=70%..80%. Keep the silhouette about four times wider than tall. Two unequal low lateral veils, shallow rolling wisps, modest short granular arcs, a mostly clear centre. There is no dense vertical central column, no towering splash and no solid accumulated ridge. Preserve at least 12% fully empty transparent margins on all four sides; no visible pixel touches an edge.
Rendering: realistic hand-painted 2.5D game VFX, near-ground side view with a very slight view of the top of the spread. Restrained physically believable material colour, subtle neutral upper-left daylight, readable at 250px wide. Soft natural alpha feathering, no rectangular haze boundary, no thick outline. The effect contains only moving suspended particles and low airborne material, not terrain.
Output ONE individual landscape RGBA PNG with TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND, ideally exactly1536×1024. No ship, capsule, engine, visible thruster, vertical exhaust plume, explosion, fire, magical energy, character, scenery, floor, opaque ground disc, cast background shadow, text, frame, grid, sprite sheet, numbered panels, contact sheet, checkerboard, black or white background, watermark or cropped particles.
